machine_check.reason: No independently checked proof artifact exists. Sketches remain human-reviewed conditional arguments. The sealed PATH has no usable z3, lean, coqc, or cvc5. Universal-Python proof work was not initiated.

decision_vocabulary.tested_premise: Qualification evidence supports this premise on the named call chain and only on that chain.
decision_vocabulary.trusted_limitation: Required by the argument and retained as an explicit assumption; not proved of the whole forest or of untested paths.
decision_vocabulary.undischarged: The argument cannot treat this as established. Unknown, incomplete, or missing campaigns stay visible.
decision_vocabulary.unavailable: The named mechanism or profile is absent from the sealed environment and is not simulated as success.
decision_vocabulary.fail_closed_not_completeness: The implementation rejects or falls back, which prevents silent discharge but does not prove the complementary completeness property.

statements.name: acceptance invariant
statements.scope: One accepted-lineage publication under a declared artifact policy; not all process writes and not a distributed transaction.
statements.conclusion: Publish(s') implies CurrentParent, Authorized, Scoped, CompleteManifest, EvidenceAdmitted, and CAS.
statements.argument: Definitional implication from the unique publication operation. The converse is not claimed.
not_established: universal enforcement by unexamined write paths

statements.name: accepted-lineage induction
statements.scope: Roots reachable solely through accepted publication transitions of FA-EQ2 under fixed Θ and PΘ.
statements.conclusion: Every such reachable root satisfies PΘ.
statements.argument: Induction on successful CAS-linearized publications. Failed, stale, incomplete, and simulated attempts are not successors.
statements.nonvacuity: complete-manifest publication exists (NS-012/NS-013); deny-all is not the witness
not_established: sole publication path in the whole forest

statements.name: dependency-projected test reuse
statements.scope: Transfer of a previous setup/call/teardown observation under declared profile θ.
statements.conclusion: Equal complete projections imply equal observations; previous observations transfer only inside that profile.
statements.argument: Function application of fθ. Completeness and determinism of πD are the hard premises and are not proved.

statements.name: three acceptance questions
statements.conclusion: Behavioral correctness, action permission, and publication are independent decisions.
statements.argument: A proof of behavior is not a permission grant; a permission grant is not a lineage publication.
not_established: durable real-tool authorization beyond the reference evaluator

statements.name: composed supervision loop
statements.scope: The specified 17-line control flow. Executed composition is claimed only for the NS-013 integrated witness subset.
statements.conclusion: The algorithm specifies the composition to evaluate. Isolated stop paths do not establish the complete loop.
statements.argument: Control-flow specification retained for comparison. Integrated witness maps to a proper subset of lines.

assumptions.name: initial-root policy
assumptions.statement: The initial accepted root satisfies PΘ.

qualification.observation: NS-013 publishes from parent seal ips.forest.genesis@1 under policy sha256:f711f00ed99912349c04196f2348905f2c299cb72fccdef83b03154cc0339f39. Genesis is a trusted starting root, not an independently proved interesting PΘ.

assumptions.limitation: The induction assumes the initial root. It does not prove that genesis satisfies an interesting policy beyond being the named parent of the tested publication.

assumptions.name: complete-manifest
assumptions.statement: The requirement manifest is complete under an admitted completeness rule. Membership of some units is never completeness.

qualification.observation: Empty, missing, duplicate, reordered, and membership-only sets return incomplete_manifest. NS-013 empty requirement manifest while the obligation remained required returned incomplete_manifest with sealed=false.

assumptions.limitation: Completeness is relative to the declared requirement set of the tested sealer profile, not to an unstated universal obligation inventory.

assumptions.name: checker
assumptions.statement: Each accepted evidence item satisfies its designated checker relation and evidence class. Solver results, axiom lookup, and kernel reconstruction remain distinct.

qualification.observation: Admission rejects unvalidated solver results, simulated required units, and unknown proof systems. TDFOL axiom lookup is non-kernel. Independent pytest is the behavioral checker in NS-008/NS-013.

assumptions.limitation: A designated checker establishes only its named evidence class. Membership, signed observation, aggregation, and direct execution are not interchangeable.

assumptions.name: translation
assumptions.statement: Lossy or unsupported translations cannot discharge source-level temporal or deontic obligations. Unknown, timeout, unsupported, and unavailable solver outcomes are not proofs.

qualification.observation: Modal erasure O(Done)/Done and until-as-conjunction are quarantined. Finite-trace SAFETY(p) is false when p holds only at step 0. source_claim_admitted is false on every NS-009 row. Z3 is unsupported.

assumptions.limitation: Supported translations progress at their declared assurance only. They do not lift to kernel completion of source claims. SMT SAT/UNSAT is unavailable, not simulated.

assumptions.name: current-parent
assumptions.statement: Publication names the expected current parent. A delta against a superseded parent cannot move the pointer.

qualification.observation: stale_parent_cannot_overwrite returns stale_parent without moving the current pointer. DurableCoordinationStore generation tokens reject ABA-stale operational writers.

assumptions.limitation: Tested on the WAL/CAS sealer and operational generation token. Not a claim about every pointer in Git or remote stores.

assumptions.name: exclusive-publication
assumptions.statement: Compare-and-swap linearizes concurrent same-parent writers. Losers are not accepted successors. Publication is the unique accepted-lineage constructor in the argument's successor relation.

qualification.observation: Six concurrent same-parent writers produce exactly one published generation; losers are stale_parent. Sequential and parallel worker counts 1, 2, 4, and 8 produce identical roots, inventories, and dispositions.

assumptions.limitation: Exclusivity is the sealer CAS linearization. A-SOLE-PUBLICATION-PATH separately records that other write paths are not proved absent.

assumptions.name: protected-authority
assumptions.statement: Policy and checker identities cannot change under ordinary worker authority. Action permission is not behavioral correctness and not publication.

qualification.observation: PreImplementationKernel.evaluate admits analytical_unique_mapping only with current bindings and denies residual dispatch without typed receipts. Alice EXECUTE_TASK is permitted; mallory is denied. NS-015 records no worker self-promotion of protected validators. closes_claim is not independent success.

assumptions.limitation: Permission tests use the reference evaluator on frozen qualification tasks. Durable real-tool integration and production model identity remain out of scope.

assumptions.name: deterministic observation/effect projection
assumptions.statement: A complete projection πD and deterministic fθ exist such that Obsθ(t,s)=fθ(πD(s)) on all states admitted by the reuse policy.

qualification.observation: Unchanged eligible reuse hits proof_cache_hit. Fixture, plugin, policy, runtime-trace, and snapshot mutations force RUN. Teardown failure blocks admitted receipts. Call reuse after setup still runs teardown.

assumptions.limitation: Fail-closed identity mismatch is qualified. Completeness of πD for arbitrary pytest, clocks, network, DB, and unmodeled plugins is not proved. Universal dependency closure is not inferred.

assumptions.name: exact-input
assumptions.statement: Required subject bytes and dependency references are verified. Stale fingerprints, stale formula roots, and colliding assertion IDs fail closed.

qualification.observation: Stale formula roots, stale solver fingerprints, fixture-set mismatches, duplicate assertion IDs, mtime-only hash memos, and invisible preimages fail closed. Hash memos require content and profile reverification.

assumptions.limitation: Exact-input checks apply to the named identity fields of the qualified adapters, not to unspecified external state.

assumptions.name: trusted-effect / external side-effect atomicity
assumptions.statement: Physical side effects outside the tested WAL/CAS/lifecycle boundary occur exactly once.

qualification.observation: Restart retains admitted evidence inside the WAL/CAS/lifecycle boundary. Duplicate recovery events do not invent a second success. NS-012 explicitly does not claim external exactly-once side effects.

assumptions.limitation: External side-effect atomicity is not inferred from local CAS. Federation, libp2p/MCP, and remote stores remain unavailable.

assumptions.name: unknown specifications
assumptions.statement: Unknown, timeout, unsupported, and unavailable outcomes are not proofs and cannot complete kernel-required source claims.

qualification.observation: unknown_not_proved, timeout_budget_exhausted, unsupported_clause_uncovered, opaque_clause_uncovered, sat_smt_unavailable, and unsat_smt_unavailable remain distinct from proof. source_claim_admitted stays false.

assumptions.limitation: Unknown specifications stay visible. They are not closed by the acceptance argument.

assumptions.name: inconsistent specifications
assumptions.statement: Unsatisfiable G making G⇒A vacuously true is not a proof of A. Mutating axioms to close a proof is a new authorized specification change.

gate.symbol: vacuity / reachability checks in NS-009 cases

qualification.observation: vacuity_unsat_guarantee is rejected as proof. reachability_gap records unreachable assumptions. Unknown is not treated as inconsistent.

assumptions.limitation: Inconsistent specifications are not silently repaired. They remain a specification problem, not an automatic proof.

assumptions.name: incomplete projections
assumptions.statement: Equal digests of incomplete manifests, incomplete runtime traces, opaque objects, and uncontrolled fixture values do not satisfy πD completeness.

qualification.observation: incomplete_trace, uncontrolled_fixture_value, and opaque_object_serialization_rejected fall back to RUN or reject. Collection seeds never become passing outcomes.

assumptions.limitation: Fail-closed fallback prevents silent reuse of incomplete projections. It does not prove that remaining keys are complete projections.

assumptions.name: universal dependency closure
assumptions.statement: πD captures every observationally relevant dependency of arbitrary tests, including clocks, network, databases, plugins, and unmodeled effects.

qualification.observation: NS-010 qualifies identity fields that are present. It does not prove that every possible dependency is in the key. The draft itself says a cold oracle and adversarial mutations do not prove universal closure.

assumptions.limitation: Universal dependency closure is not inferred from equal execution-key digests.

assumptions.name: independent cold-oracle reuse scoring
assumptions.statement: An independent cold full runner agrees with admitted reuse on every scored case, with false-reuse denominators.

qualification.observation: papers/completion/neurosymbolic_supervision/qualification/cold_oracle_results.jsonl is absent. papers/completion/neurosymbolic_supervision/receipts/NS-011.json is absent. NS-010 assigns this campaign to NS-011 and does not claim it.

assumptions.limitation: Cold-oracle agreement is not discharged. No false-reuse rate is reported.

assumptions.name: sole publication operation
assumptions.statement: The tested sealer is the only operation that can introduce an accepted-lineage successor.

qualification.observation: The induction's successor relation is defined as the sealer's successful CAS publications. Other persist APIs were not shown to be absent from the loaded forest.

assumptions.limitation: Trusted for the argument's successor relation. Not a whole-program uniqueness proof.

assumptions.name: native theorem/circuit profile
assumptions.statement: A genuine Groth16/circuit proof binds inner public inputs to outer source, obligation, and test-inventory claims.

qualification.observation: The named native-proof profile is unavailable. No genuine proof payload, verified key/circuit, or measured prove/verify time is retained. Help-CLI observation is not a proof.

assumptions.limitation: Native proving is out of scope. Horn-fragment helpers do not establish CPython/pytest execution.

assumptions.name: composition-edge / interpolant / incremental SMT
assumptions.statement: Named CompositionEdge, interpolating QF_LIA CEGAR, interpolant checker, cyclic assume-guarantee closure, and incremental SMT wrapper discharge component obligations.

qualification.observation: IPA refine_spurious_paths is located and exercised. CompositionEdge, interpolant checker, cyclic closure, QF_LIA interpolating adapter, and incremental SMT wrapper were not located and are not simulated.

assumptions.limitation: Unlocated specification-only mechanisms cannot discharge the acceptance argument.

assumptions.name: world/procedure/refactoring consumption
assumptions.statement: Required-mode world or procedure consumption exhibits pre-state, accepted transition, and post-state publication.

qualification.observation: No procedure, world-consumption, or refactoring extension is retained. Table 18 world/procedure row is untested/out of scope.

assumptions.limitation: Algorithm 1 line 17 learning and world-root composition remain intended-only.
